_metadata.purpose: Inference-only Small Language Model with a 128-token vocabulary and analytically constructed, 100% interpretable parameters for academic demonstration.
_metadata.parameter_source_methodology: Analytical 16D Orthogonal Subspace, 3-Bit Hypercube Lexical Coding, and LayerNorm Hypersphere (radius=4.0) Matched-Filter Construction.
theoretical_references: Vaswani et al. (2017) - Attention Is All You Need (Scaled Dot-Product & Multi-Head Attention)
Radford et al. (2019) - Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners (GPT-2 Pre-LN Decoder)
Elhage et al. (2021) - A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits (Attention Context Routing)
Geva et al. (2021) - Transformer Feed-Forward Layers Are Key-Value Memories (FFN Associative Rules)

vocabulary_categories.description: Pre-nominal modifiers (small, quick, smart, neural, clinical, cosmic, ...)
Clause agents (cat, dog, student, professor, model, transformer, doctor, telescope, ...)
Action predicates (sat, ran, reads, writes, predicts, encodes, treats, observes, ...)
Spatial/relational linkers (on, in, near, under, with, through, ...)
Clause targets (mat, garden, books, papers, tokens, vectors, patients, stars, ...)

embedding_dimension_meanings.12: Lexical Sub-Identity Bit 0 (3D Hypercube X-axis ±2.4 within category)
embedding_dimension_meanings.13: Lexical Sub-Identity Bit 1 (3D Hypercube Y-axis ±2.4 within category)
embedding_dimension_meanings.14: Lexical Sub-Identity Bit 2 (3D Hypercube Z-axis ±2.4 within category)
embedding_dimension_meanings.15: Attention-Routed Context Register (written by Head 1 to disambiguate prepositional phrases)

ffn_neuron_descriptions: N01 [Init 'the'->'cat']   : Initial 'the' (no prior preposition) -> Predict subject 'cat'
N28 [Routed 'on the']     : 'the' + Head-1 routed 'on' (dim15+, dim7+) -> Predict 'mat'
N29 [Routed 'in the']     : 'the' + Head-1 routed 'in' (dim15+, dim8+) -> Predict 'garden'

W_E.layer: 1. Token Embedding Layer (128 tokens x 16 dims)
W_E.source_explanation: Zero-centered 16D basis: dims 0..6 encode Part-of-Speech, dims 7..11 encode 5 Semantic Domains (Physical, Academic, AI, Medical, Astronomy), dims 12..14 assign a unique 3-bit hypercube vertex (±2.4, ±2.4, ±2.4) to each word in its bucket (max pairwise cosine = 0.8245 across all 128 tokens).

W_P.layer: 2. Positional Encoding Layer (12 positions x 16 dims)
W_P.source_explanation: Zero-mean sinusoidal position waves (amplitude 0.03) across positions 0..11 to break permutation invariance while preserving semantic axes.

ln1_gamma_beta.mathematical_formula: LN_1(x) = gamma_1 * (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) + beta_1
ln1_gamma_beta.source_explanation: Unit gain (gamma_1 = 1) and zero bias (beta_1 = 0); projects each 16D token vector onto the zero-mean sphere of exact radius sqrt(16) = 4.0000.

W_Q_b_Q.source_explanation: 4 Heads (d_head=4): Head 0 (cols 0..3) queries syntax; Head 1 (cols 4..7) fires when current token is Determiner 'the' (dim 1) to search past context for Prepositions ('on'/'in'); Head 2 (cols 8..11) queries domain; Head 3 (cols 12..15) queries lexical sub-identity.

W_K_b_K.source_explanation: Head 1 Col 4 exposes a strong Key (+4.0) on Prepositions (dim 5) so a subsequent determiner 'the' attends 100% to 'on' or 'in'.

W_V_b_V.source_explanation: Head 1 extracts Preposition presence (dim 5) and preposition identity (dims 7..8, distinguishing 'on' vs. 'in') from the attended preposition.

W_O_b_O.source_explanation: Writes the Head-1 routed Preposition signal into Dim 15 (Context Register) and Dims 7..8 of the residual stream, disambiguating initial '<BOS> the' (-> 'cat'), 'sat on the' (-> 'mat'), and 'ran in the' (-> 'garden').

ln2_gamma_beta.mathematical_formula: LN_2(x) = gamma_2 * (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) + beta_2
ln2_gamma_beta.source_explanation: Normalizes the post-attention residual stream onto the sphere of exact Euclidean radius ||z||_2 = sqrt(16) = 4.0000 for matched-filter detection.

W_1_b_1.layer: 6a. Feed-Forward Network: Key Detector Matrix (W_1, b_1)
W_1_b_1.source_explanation: 40 Spherical Matched-Filter Columns (N00..N39): Column j is 6.0 * u_j (unit post-attention state of Rule j) with bias b_1 = -21.60 (cos > 0.90 cone threshold on the radius-4.0 sphere).

W_2_b_2.layer: 6b. Feed-Forward Network: Value Transition Matrix (W_2, b_2)
W_2_b_2.source_explanation: 40 Associative Memory Value Rows: Row j equals 8.0 * W_E[target_token_j] - h^(1)_j, steering the residual stream toward the predicted next token's 16D embedding.

ln_f_gamma_beta.source_explanation: Normalizes the final 16D residual stream before unembedding projection.

W_LM_b_LM.source_explanation: Weight-tied transpose of unit-normalized 128x16 Token Embeddings (4.5 * W_E_unit^T) plus prior bias b_LM (-12.0 on <PAD> and <BOS>).
